description: Declared mutants of the orchestration skeleton batch (docs/architecture/target/v2/orchestration-skeleton-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 9; ids or-). Behaviour tests only: the scans of section 7.4 wait for the scenario segment (v8-arch-gyo2-guards-after-mechanism-stable). G-8 (Fable/high, build/evidence/gyo2-orchestration-skeleton/segment1/g8-check-fable-high.md) added g8- candidates; not added (with the reason): g8-owner-seq-constant: no observable behaviour of the owner sequence (the kernel only compares owners for equality); g8-replace-inside-run-unchecked: equivalent under test: the kernel asserts too (W-3), GYO_CHECK_ASSERTS takes any assertion; g8-old-registry-first: undefined behaviour (use after free) without a sanitizer: not a reliable mutant; g8-carry-box-kept: equivalent for the carried types (one int; move equals copy). v8-arch-gyo2-broken-world-ends-product (user decision, merge approval item 4): one broken World ends the Product. Retired with their property: or-carry-held-dropped (the holding place is gone (an empty place ends the Product; g8s-drop-old-held-dropped guards the values a DropOldFirst replacement takes out)); or-d1-hold-not-old (an interrupted World is not replaced any more); g8-runon-unchecked (RunOn checks nothing now; Ended() at each entry point does (or-ended-*)); g8-runframe-interrupted-unchecked (or-ended-runframe-unchecked); g8-insert-empty-place-code (or-ended-insert-unchecked and or-ended-code-swapped). Rewritten for the new code (find only, or as noted in what): or-gi-last-world, or-gi-error-ignored, g8-gi-flag-only-on-success, or-runschedule-no-gameinit, g8s-runschedule-gameinit-after, or-drop-old-later, g8-frame-list-reversed, g8-frame-error-ignored, g8-replace-gameinit-skipped-on-new, g8-swap-keeps-old-lists, g8-throw-no-giveback, g8s-drop-old-held-dropped, or-d4-empty-first-counted. Added: or-ended-*, or-failure-*, or-drop-fail-*, or-throw-*, or-run-throw-unrecorded. The same day the user took the logging back out (logging is a mechanism of its own, not part of the orchestration layer): the log parameter and its or-log-* mutants never landed; or-failure-logged guards that the layer does not log. time-events step 4 (v8-arch-gyo2-time-events, declaration 6.1 G2 and G6): retired or-gi-domain-unchecked (G2: a game initialization schedule no longer belongs to a domain, D-E12 left the kernel) and or-failure-no-domain (G6: WorldFailure carries no domain); rewrote or-failure-no-tick and or-failure-text-no-tick for the sync point number. time-events step 4 adds the or-skeleton- mutants of the default schedule skeleton (O-4; declaration 3.6). time-events step 6 adds sc-s2-real-time-carried (scenario segment 2, S2-8: RealTime is not carried over a World replacement).
